title: Ethical and Explainable AI in Reusable MLOps Pipelines
reasoning: The paper's core objective is to operationalize and evaluate ethical AI principles, specifically fairness and transparency, within a machine learning framework. It implements and benchmarks automated 'fairness gates' (using metrics like Demographic Parity Difference and Equalised Odds) to ensure ethical adherence during the model deployment lifecycle, referencing standards such as the EU AI Act.
